about.title: About Me
about.description1: Hi, I'm Ridho Norfajar, born in Banjarmasin on May 15, 2009. I'm a 12th-grade student at Vocational High School 2 Banjarmasin majoring in Software and Game Development. My education started at Public Elementary School Pangeran 2, continued at Islamic Junior High School Al-Huda, and is now focused on building strong technical skills. I'm passionate about web development and constantly improve my abilities as a web developer.
about.description2: During my outdoor learning program, I worked as the second web developer, responsible for developing and updating the Guidance Counseling website of Vocational High School 2 Banjarmasin. Although I haven't joined any organizations yet, this experience strengthened my technical skills and work ethic. My goal is to work as a freelance programmer or join an IT company where I can keep growing and creating meaningful digital solutions.
